# Pinterest Mexico

> > Pinterest Mexico (mx.pinterest.com) - Visual discovery platform featuring user profiles, curated boards, shopping, and creative ideas across architecture, fashion, DIY, and educational content.

This is the Mexican regional version of Pinterest, serving Spanish and Russian-speaking users with personalized content discovery, brand profiles (Google MX, BuzzFeed, Amazing Architecture), and shopping features. The platform includes extensive tutorial content, creative inspiration boards, and social profiles spanning multiple languages and interests.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest boards and profiles
- Visual discovery and ideas
- Shopping and e-commerce
- Drawing and art tutorials
- Architecture and design
- Fashion and style inspiration
- DIY crafts and projects
- Educational content
- Russian-language content
- Spanish-language content
- Brand profiles (Google MX, BuzzFeed, Amazing Architecture)
- User authentication and login
- Community helpers and learning
- Web development guides
- Digital art tools

## Core Platform Features

- [Pinterest Mexico Homepage](https://mx.pinterest.com/"): Pinterest Mexico homepage with login and signup for discovering ideas
- [Explore Ideas Hub](https://mx.pinterest.com/ideas): Main Pinterest ideas hub with category browsing and trending content
- [Pinterest Login](https://mx.pinterest.com/mex): Private user profile for Sarahí with restricted access login page
- [Pinterest Login (Alternative)](https://mx.pinterest.com/pin/1829656095459116): Pinterest login page with autocomplete and authentication interface
